name: list_dir
description:
- Efficiently explores file system structure
- Lists one directory level: directories first, then files, each sorted by name; files include their size
- The last line reports a Summary with file/dir counts
- Results are limited to 500 items by default; set limit to get more (<=0 means no limit)
- Use this tool when you need to understand the directory structure or find files in a specific path

path.description: The path to the directory to list. Defaults to the current working directory. IMPORTANT: Omit this field to use the default directory. DO NOT enter "undefined" or "null" - simply omit it for the default behavior. Must be a valid directory path if provided.

limit.description: Optional: Maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 500; set to 0 or less for no limit.
